strengths: Exact CL:0000794 supported by direct positive markers Cd3d/Cd3e/Cd3g/Trac/Trbc1/Trbc2 and Cd8a/Cd8b1.
Correctly integrates cytotoxic effector genes Gzmb/Gzmk/Ifng/Ccl5/Nkg7/Fasl into the identity.
Appropriately down-weighted the single gamma-delta TCR gene Trgv2 in favor of overwhelming alpha-beta TCR evidence.
weaknesses: State-level effector-memory speculation extends somewhat beyond the directly supported ontology identity.
Quantitative candidate scores were not available for independent verification.

strengths: Correctly identifies the T-cell lineage from Cd3d/Cd3e/Cd3g/Trac/Trbc1/Trbc2 markers.
Conservative broad-level call avoids over-committing to a subtype.
weaknesses: Under-specific: directly supported Cd8a/Cd8b1 and cytotoxic effector program are omitted from the top1 label.
Rank2 CD8-positive alpha-beta T cell (CL:0000625) is better but still lacks the directly supported cytotoxic component.

strengths: Exact CL:0000794 supported by direct markers Cd3d/Cd3e/Cd3g/Trac/Trbc1/Trbc2/Cd8a/Cd8b1.
Correctly distinguishes T cells from NK cells using TCR complex and CD8 co-receptor evidence despite shared cytotoxic genes.
weaknesses: Part of the reasoning relies on absence of NK markers (Ncr1/Klrb1c/Il2rb) rather than positive lineage-defining markers.
Enrichment list includes generic pathways that are not discriminative on their own.

supporting: Original DEGs include T-cell receptor complex genes Cd3d/Cd3e/Cd3g/Trac/Trbc1/Trbc2 and CD8 co-receptor genes Cd8a/Cd8b1.
Cytotoxic effector identity is directly supported by Gzmb/Gzmk/Ifng/Ccl5/Nkg7/Fasl.
Enrichment evidence includes alpha-beta T cell receptor complex and T cell receptor signaling pathway.
PMID 34500759 is among the original evidence citations supporting the CD8+ T-cell annotation.
conflicting: Trgv2 (gamma-delta TCR) and NK-associated genes Klrc1/Klrk1/Nkg7 are present but insufficient to shift the dominant alpha-beta CD8 T-cell identity.
In-house top1 'T cell' is not incorrect but omits directly supported CD8 and cytotoxic specificity.
